title: Honeybee poster
explanation: A step-by-step answer lets you check each step against the one before. One line added a fact the steps never listed, and one made up a number. Both are easy to spot when the steps are on the page.
setup: Do this in steps. Step 1: list three facts about honeybees. Step 2: use only those three facts to write two sentences for a poster.

sentences.text: Step 1: Honeybees live in colonies with one queen.
Honeybees visit flowers to collect nectar and pollen.
A worker bee makes only a tiny amount of honey in her whole life.
Step 2: Honeybees live in colonies and visit flowers to collect nectar and pollen.
Honeybees also do a waggle dance to share where flowers are.
sentences.note: The order said to use only the three facts from Step 1. The waggle dance is true, but it was never in the list.

sentences.text: A single hive holds about five million bees.
sentences.note: A hive holds tens of thousands of bees, not millions. This number was made up.
